svg.title: Compaction decision costs and resident-memory corroboration

cc:Work.dc:title: Compaction decision costs and resident-memory corroboration
cc:Work.dc:description: Selection overhead and resident-memory corroboration for every native compaction scenario. Decision percentage and resident recovery percentage are medians of per-trial ratios. No-release cells have no defined resident-recovery ratio. No full-program or macOS-kernel gain claim. Source SHA-256 cffe40f7fd406ac3c1b8945d22e799338cd923d1768c6d6780443c68e0a07b69. Rendered with Matplotlib 3.10.9.
